basis: Current design Page phase table and minimal P2 demonstration paragraph; scope is retained rather than replaced by existing prototype coverage.

phases.evidence: Protocol contracts, canonical codec and local vectors exist. Restricted public gateway CDDL and signed framing are specified; independent validation remains open.
phases.open: Complete object family, independent interoperability, general policy and observable protocol remain.

phases.evidence: Finite lifecycle/observation/retention models and weakened-rule counterexamples exist. public_transcript_contract.json adds a bounded full-observation simulator with adaptive mixed queries, controls, polling, ordering, transport faults and expiry; seven runtime refinement gates are tracked; OBS-2 and OBS-3 now have tested atomic publication and domain-wide final-prefix reference implementations; independent cryptographic refinement remains open. OBS-1/OBS-5 now have a signed public journal and exact-recovery reference; OBS-4 remains partial. public_observation_contract.json adds 32 paired runtime traces and actual-network private-failure counterexamples; not a full proof or exhaustive distribution test.
phases.open: Full cryptographic and implementation refinement, arbitrary concurrency/liveness and observation proof remain.

phases.evidence: prototype/p2_scenario_contract.json maps the nine reference steps. contribution_delivery_contract.json now covers fixed-roster ingestion through the complete authenticated retention-v2 scenario; combined recovery audits, terminal closure/archive and six local process cuts are separately tested. atomic_publication_contract.json verifies publication/L3/decision atomicity and new-state recovery under reference and loopback authenticated witness. ordered_publication_contract.json verifies domain-wide final prefix, guarded preparation and exact recovery, with two recipient TLS services and local crash cuts. public_gateway_contract.json verifies signed five-method public ingress, request/effect/response atomicity, public controls/polls/final pages and exact response recovery; actual mTLS submit/reply loss/full histogram result/final-query scenario passed. Public input syntax and output vocabulary are explicit; selected policy denials corrected and gateway regression rerun.
